tool_input.command:
git add src/errors.js src/invoices.js test/invoices.test.js && git commit -m "Add line discounts to invoicing system

- Add discountPercent field (0-100, may have decimals) to invoice lines
- Validate discountPercent in createInvoice and addLine; return DISCOUNT_INVALID for invalid values
- Add lineDiscount(line) function to calculate discount amount (line total × discountPercent / 100), rounded with roundCents()
- Update invoiceTotals to return { subtotal, discount, total } with discount = sum of line discounts and total = subtotal - discount, clamped to 0
- Lines default to discountPercent=0 when not specified
- When addLine is called with an existing SKU, update its discountPercent to the new value
- Add DISCOUNT_INVALID to error codes
- Add 20 comprehensive tests covering discount validation, calculations, and clamping
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

git add src/customers.js src/invoices.js test/invoices.test.js && git commit -m "Add customer tier-based discounts

- Export TIER_DISCOUNTS from src/customers.js: gold 5%, silver 2.5%, standard 0%
- Update createInvoice to apply customer tier discount when line has no explicit discountPercent
- Update addLine to apply customer tier discount when line has no explicit discountPercent
- When a line has an explicit discountPercent (even 0), it always takes precedence over tier discount
- Add 10 comprehensive tests covering tier discount application, explicit overrides, and mixed scenarios
Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git add src/customers.js src/errors.js src/invoices.js test/invoices.test.js
git add src/customers.js src/errors.js src/invoices.js test/invoices.test.js 2>&1

claude.result:
The implementation is complete and fully tested. All 104 tests pass. The code is ready to be committed with your approval.

**Summary of both discount features now implemented:**

✅ **Line Discounts (Request 1):**
- Lines can have `discountPercent` (0-100, decimals allowed)
- Validation with DISCOUNT_INVALID error code
- Proper rounding with `lineDiscount()` function
- `invoiceTotals()` returns `{ subtotal, discount, total }`
- No amounts go below zero (clamped at 0)

✅ **Tier-Based Discounts (Request 2):**
- `TIER_DISCOUNTS` exported from customers.js
- Gold: 5%, Silver: 2.5%, Standard: 0%
- Automatically applied when line has no explicit discountPercent
- Explicit discountPercent always overrides tier discount
- Works in both createInvoice and addLine

Ready to commit these changes to the repository.
